answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock tokens before it can vote or earn, and proven misbehavior burns that bond. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds, so the attack's cost grows with every identity while its rewards do not. Picture a sparrow flock landing on a mesa: if each bird had to pay a pinch of saffron to perch, a fake swarm would go broke long before it could outvote honest agents.
